<?php

namespace App\Api\Http;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\BadRequestHttpException;

/**
 * Parsing and validation of the query string, path ids, customer header and JSON bodies.
 */
final class RequestInput
{
    public const DEFAULT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 10;
    public const MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 50;
    public const MAX_INT = 2147483647;

    public static function page(Request $request): int
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, 'page');
        if (null === $value) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $value) || (int) $value < 1) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Invalid page parameter.');
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    public static function itemsPerPage(Request $request): int
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, 'itemsPerPage');
        if (null === $value) {
            return self::DEFAULT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $value) || (int) $value < 1 || (int) $value > self::MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('itemsPerPage must be between 1 and %d.', self::MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE));
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $allowed sort field => SQL column
     *
     * @return array<string, string> SQL column => ASC|DESC, in the order given
     */
    public static function orders(Request $request, array $allowed): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get('order');
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Invalid order parameter.');
        }

        $orders = [];
        foreach ($value as $field => $direction) {
            if (!isset($allowed[$field])) {
                throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Unknown sort field "%s".', $field));
            }
            if (!is_string($direction) || !in_array($direction, ['asc', 'desc'], true)) {
                throw new BadRequestHttpException('Sort direction must be asc or desc.');
            }
            $orders[$allowed[$field]] = strtoupper($direction);
        }

        return $orders;
    }

    public static function scalar(Request $request, string $name): ?string
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!is_string($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s parameter.', $name));
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * @param string[] $operators
     *
     * @return array<string, string> operator => integer text
     */
    public static function integerRange(Request $request, string $name, array $operators): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s filter.', $name));
        }

        $range = [];
        foreach ($operators as $operator) {
            if (!array_key_exists($operator, $value)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!is_string($value[$operator]) || !preg_match('/^-?[0-9]+$/', $value[$operator])) {
                throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s[%s] filter, integer expected.', $name, $operator));
            }
            $range[$operator] = $value[$operator];
        }

        return $range;
    }

    /**
     * @param string[] $operators
     *
     * @return array<string, string> operator => Y-m-d
     */
    public static function dateRange(Request $request, string $name, array $operators): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s filter.', $name));
        }

        $range = [];
        foreach ($operators as $operator) {
            if (array_key_exists($operator, $value)) {
                $range[$operator] = self::date($value[$operator], sprintf('%s[%s]', $name, $operator));
            }
        }

        return $range;
    }

    public static function boolean(Request $request, string $name): ?bool
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, $name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return null;
        }
        if ('true' === $value) {
            return true;
        }
        if ('false' === $value) {
            return false;
        }
        throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('%s must be true or false.', $name));
    }

    public static function requiredDate(Request $request, string $name): string
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, $name);
        if (null === $value) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('%s is required.', $name));
        }

        return self::date($value, $name);
    }

    public static function date(mixed $value, string $name): string
    {
        if (!is_string($value) || !preg_match('/^([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})$/', $value, $m) || !checkdate((int) $m[2], (int) $m[3], (int) $m[1])) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('%s must be a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD).', $name));
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Path identifier. Malformed or out-of-range ids are not found rather than bad requests.
     */
    public static function pathId(mixed $value): ?int
    {
        if (!is_string($value) || !preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $value)) {
            return null;
        }
        $id = (int) $value;

        return $id >= 1 && $id <= self::MAX_INT ? $id : null;
    }

    /**
     * Value of the X-Customer-Id header, null when missing or malformed.
     */
    public static function customerId(?string $value): ?int
    {
        return self::pathId($value);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed> the decoded JSON object
     */
    public static function jsonObject(Request $request): array
    {
        try {
            $data = json_decode($request->getContent(), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (\JsonException) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Request body must be valid JSON.');
        }
        if (!is_array($data) || array_is_list($data)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Request body must be a JSON object.');
        }

        return $data;
    }
}

namespace App\Api\Http;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\BadRequestHttpException;

/**
 * Parsing and validation of the query string, path ids, customer header and JSON bodies.
 */
final class RequestInput
{
    public const DEFAULT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 10;
    public const MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = 50;
    public const MAX_INT = 2147483647;

    public static function page(Request $request): int
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, 'page');
        if (null === $value) {
            return 1;
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $value) || (int) $value < 1) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Invalid page parameter.');
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    public static function itemsPerPage(Request $request): int
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, 'itemsPerPage');
        if (null === $value) {
            return self::DEFAULT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE;
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $value) || (int) $value < 1 || (int) $value > self::MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('itemsPerPage must be between 1 and %d.', self::MAX_ITEMS_PER_PAGE));
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $allowed sort field => SQL column
     *
     * @return array<string, string> SQL column => ASC|DESC, in the order given
     */
    public static function orders(Request $request, array $allowed): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get('order');
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Invalid order parameter.');
        }

        $orders = [];
        foreach ($value as $field => $direction) {
            if (!isset($allowed[$field])) {
                throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Unknown sort field "%s".', $field));
            }
            if (!is_string($direction) || !in_array($direction, ['asc', 'desc'], true)) {
                throw new BadRequestHttpException('Sort direction must be asc or desc.');
            }
            $orders[$allowed[$field]] = strtoupper($direction);
        }

        return $orders;
    }

    public static function scalar(Request $request, string $name): ?string
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!is_string($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s parameter.', $name));
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * @param string[] $operators
     *
     * @return array<string, string> operator => integer text
     */
    public static function integerRange(Request $request, string $name, array $operators): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s filter.', $name));
        }

        $range = [];
        foreach ($operators as $operator) {
            if (!array_key_exists($operator, $value)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!is_string($value[$operator]) || !preg_match('/^-?[0-9]+$/', $value[$operator])) {
                throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s[%s] filter, integer expected.', $name, $operator));
            }
            $range[$operator] = $value[$operator];
        }

        return $range;
    }

    /**
     * @param string[] $operators
     *
     * @return array<string, string> operator => Y-m-d
     */
    public static function dateRange(Request $request, string $name, array $operators): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('Invalid %s filter.', $name));
        }

        $range = [];
        foreach ($operators as $operator) {
            if (array_key_exists($operator, $value)) {
                $range[$operator] = self::date($value[$operator], sprintf('%s[%s]', $name, $operator));
            }
        }

        return $range;
    }

    public static function boolean(Request $request, string $name): ?bool
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, $name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return null;
        }
        if ('true' === $value) {
            return true;
        }
        if ('false' === $value) {
            return false;
        }
        throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('%s must be true or false.', $name));
    }

    public static function requiredDate(Request $request, string $name): string
    {
        $value = self::scalar($request, $name);
        if (null === $value) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('%s is required.', $name));
        }

        return self::date($value, $name);
    }

    public static function date(mixed $value, string $name): string
    {
        if (!is_string($value) || !preg_match('/^([0-9]{4})-([0-9]{2})-([0-9]{2})$/', $value, $m) || !checkdate((int) $m[2], (int) $m[3], (int) $m[1])) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException(sprintf('%s must be a valid date (YYYY-MM-DD).', $name));
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Path identifier. Malformed or out-of-range ids are not found rather than bad requests.
     */
    public static function pathId(mixed $value): ?int
    {
        if (!is_string($value) || !preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $value)) {
            return null;
        }
        $id = (int) $value;

        return $id >= 1 && $id <= self::MAX_INT ? $id : null;
    }

    /**
     * Value of the X-Customer-Id header, null when missing or malformed.
     */
    public static function customerId(?string $value): ?int
    {
        return self::pathId($value);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed> the decoded JSON object
     */
    public static function jsonObject(Request $request): array
    {
        try {
            $data = json_decode($request->getContent(), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (\JsonException) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Request body must be valid JSON.');
        }
        if (!is_array($data)) {
            throw new BadRequestHttpException('Request body must be a JSON object.');
        }

        return $data;
    }
}
